messages:
zoe: prepping a region-staggered rollout for peregrine-9b:v1 tonight. change window 22:00-01:00 UTC. plan: EU first (5% -> 20%), then NA (5% -> 20%) after 30m.
alan: recommend protecting paid-enterprise tenants by pinning to peregrine-9b:v0 for first 1h. will apply pin before EU cutover.
min: fallback ordering: 1) tenant pin, 2) peregrine-9b:v0, 3) ember-6b-quant. if regional capacity pressure, fallback to nearest-region variant instead of global.
sre-ops: monitoring thresholds: immediate rollback if p99 > 1600ms OR error_rate > 2x baseline sustained for 4m. also page oncall if regional qps drops > 20% for 3m. dashboard: https://console/redwood/dashboards/peregrine-9b-rollout
zoe: deploy-bot, schedule region-staggered enable and attach monitors, include runbook link.
deploy-bot: queued: /run deploy catalog enable peregrine-9b:v1 --regions=eu,na --stagger=30m --step=5%->20% --window=2026-04-02T22:00Z-01:00Z --monitors=p50,p95,p99,errors,qps --runbook=https://confluence/redwood/peregrine-rollout
alan: rollback snippet for oncall:
```
# full rollback
deploy-bot: /run deploy catalog rollback --model=peregrine-9b:v1 --to=peregrine-9b:v0 --reason="p99-latency"
# regional stop (EU only)
deploy-bot: /run deploy catalog set-traffic --model=peregrine-9b:v1 --regions=eu --percent=0
# pin enterprise for 1h
POST /catalog/pin {"selector":"paid-enterprise","model":"peregrine-9b:v0","ttl":"1h"}
```
sre-ops: note: we'll also flip on extra KV cache warming for v1 in EU pre-cutover to avoid cold-start p99 spikes.
min: i'll coordinate changelog entry and short customer-facing note. please add final perf snapshots to this thread.
zoe: applying paid-enterprise pin now. will kick EU step at +12m. assigning oncall: @alan primary @sre-ops backup for 22:00-02:00 UTC.
alan: pin applied and verified. smoke eval PASS. ready for EU 5% start.
deploy-bot: starting EU 5% now. will post metric snap at +6m and +20m.
sre-ops: +6m EU snapshot: p50=95ms p95=380ms p99=720ms errors=baseline. no alert.
min: good. move EU to 20% at +25m unless otherwise noted.
sre-ops: EU @20% steady: p99=760ms, errors normal. starting NA 5% now.
deploy-bot: NA 5% started.
alan: NA +6m: p99=820ms but within thresholds. no page.
zoe: if any region violates p99 >1600ms we rollback that region only. otherwise we'll finalize and publish changelog.
min: will remove paid-enterprise pin in 50m if stable. will publish release note to #release-notes and update catalog change entry.
alan: handing off 24h watch to platform after window. good job team. :rocket:
